ceo.notes: Идентификация надежная. В 2024 году формальная должность в ПАО "ДВМП" - Президент, а не Генеральный директор; Генеральный директор не был избран. Публикации, патенты и h-index не подтверждены, поэтому оставлены пустыми. QUALITY PASS ROUND 1 (2026-07-30): fixed a desync between the JSON and round-2 research notes -- both education[] institution strings were still the raw alias forms ("Финансовая академия при Правительстве Российской Федерации", "Московская государственная юридическая академия") even though round-2 notes and patch scripts had already established the canonical university_names.json keys for both ("Финансовый университет при Правительстве Российской Федерации", "Московский государственный юридический университет имени О.Е. Кутафина (МГЮА)"); the rename was apparently never actually persisted. Applied now; no new source needed, same citations still apply verbatim (the fa.ru source itself already uses the modern "Финансовый университет" name). Bounded honest-gap follow-up with fresh queries (not repeating round 1/2's wording) was run on the two remaining nulls: (1) 1993 Finance Academy diploma honors -- fresh queries ("красный диплом"/"с отличием" + Финансовая академия 1993) against ru.ruwiki.ru, tadviser.ru and fas.gov.ru still found honors attributed only to the 2005 MGYuA diploma, never to the 1993 one; qualification stays null, now a fourth negative check, treated as settled. (2) publications/patents/h_index -- fresh query explicitly excluding namesakes still found no ORCID/eLibrary/patent record for this Ivanov (only a same-surname MSU virologist "Иванов Пётр Алексеевич" was found and rejected on patronymic mismatch); fields remain null/empty, treated as settled given four cumulative negative passes across rounds 1/2/this round. No GICS triple in this person's record was found mislabeled on inspection (banks, transport operators/infrastructure, government bodies were all re-checked against the named organizations' real primary business and gics_taxonomy.json).

QUALITY PASS ROUND 1 (2026-07-30): bounded honest-gap follow-up with fresh queries not tried in rounds 1/2 ("Плотников Юрий Олегович ФЕСКО образование вуз до назначения биография") surfaced FESCO's own official 08.08.2019 press release announcing the expanded Management Board, which gives -- for the first time in this file -- his education (Академия ФСБ России, специальность "Юриспруденция"; Российская академия государственной службы при Президенте РФ / РАНХиГС, специальность "Государственное и муниципальное управление"), his pre-FESCO career (security-department leadership at АО "Российская электроника" and ПАО "НК "Роснефть"; before that, service in the FSB Investigative Directorate until 2013), and exact start dates for his two already-known FESCO roles (Director of PJSC DVMP from May 2019; VP for Security from June 2019; joined the Management Board 02.09.2019). Institution names written in canonical university_names.json form. qualification_degree set to 'Specialist degree' for both new education entries -- both institutions are cited by 'специальность' (not 'направление подготовки бакалавриата'), consistent with this project's established convention for pre-Bologna Russian specialty-based higher-education programs (same convention already used for Ivanov's Финансовый университет and МГЮА diplomas in this same file); confidence is moderate-high, not certain, since the source does not literally state a five-year program length. GICS triples for the three new employers: Российская электроника (Rostec-owned radio-electronics/microelectronics holding, confirmed via TAdviser) -> Information Technology/Technology Hardware & Equipment/Electronic Equipment, Instruments & Components; Роснефть -> Energy/Energy/Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels (no dedicated research needed, unambiguous); Следственное управление ФСБ России -> null/null/null, a federal security/law-enforcement body, not a GICS-classifiable commercial entity. Birth year, exact pre-2019 dates, publications, patents and h_index remain unconfirmed and null -- out of scope for this bounded follow-up (no fresh query for these was run this round; a future pass could try Kremlin/government-decree databases for a birth year and FSB-era appointment dates, which were not attempted here).

validation_notes: Processed 2 people from CSV for FESH. Checked 2 relevant local documents. Completed 2 person research rounds total, one for Ivanov and one for Plotnikov. Ivanov's 2024 role is President/Chairman of the Management Board; General Director was not elected in 2024, so President is treated as the equivalent chief executive role. Plotnikov has substantial uncertainty: education, birth year, prior career, degrees, publications, patents and h-index are not confirmed in accessible sources. Weak/auxiliary sources were used only for context; unsupported blocked-snippet education for Plotnikov was not added. Board member personal names are anonymized in the annual report; this is recorded as a disclosure limitation. Rejected namesakes include scientific/professional profiles for other Plotnikovs and generic Ivanov matches without FESCO/FAS/RZD anchors. Search is considered complete because both local PDFs were checked first, official annual-report pages confirmed 2024 roles, separate education/career/appointment/scientific searches were performed, prior employers found for Ivanov were checked, and two subsequent search passes did not produce new accessible confirmed facts for Plotnikov. GAP-FILLING ROUND (2026-07-19): Company-level sector/industry_group/industry (Industrials/Transportation/Marine Transportation (New Name), copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json) verified unchanged from a prior pass. For Ivanov: qualification_degree confirmed present on both education[] entries ('Specialist degree' - five-year Soviet/Russian diploma-specialist programs, both the 1993 Finance Academy and 2005 MGYuA degrees, predating the Bologna two-tier system, per this project's convention for that degree type) and on degrees[] ('Doctoral degree' for 'Кандидат экономических наук' - the Russian post-graduate research doctorate, per this project's convention mapping it above Master's/MBA level); both education[] institution strings were checked against university_names.json and already match the exact canonical entries (no new institutions found, none logged to new_institutions_found); sector/industry_group/industry are present on every professional_experience entry, all copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json rows, except three government bodies (Moscow Dept. of Transport and Communications, Moscow Region Government, Federal Antimonopoly Service) which are deliberately left null/null/null because GICS classifies commercial industries, not state authorities, and guessing a bucket for a ministry/service would misrepresent the taxonomy. A targeted re-check of the honors/red-diploma detail for the 1993 degree (via Wikipedia and PortNews) confirmed birth data and the 2005 MGYuA honors diploma but found no confirmation of honors for the 1993 diploma, so that qualification value intentionally remains null. For Plotnikov: sector/industry_group/industry were added to all three professional_experience entries - PJSC DVMP and OOO Transport Group FESCO classified by their own core marine/integrated-transport business as Industrials/Transportation/Marine Transportation (New Name); MADI (a state technical university, not a commercial enterprise) is left null/null/null with this reasoning recorded, since GICS has no bucket for higher-education institutions and none should be guessed. A full-text, page-by-page re-scan of both local FESH PDFs (PyMuPDF) confirmed no additional Plotnikov biography beyond the already-known page-162 mention; a targeted re-fetch of the MADI page and the FESCO annual-report executive-bodies page found no new education/birth-year/career facts for Plotnikov - education, degrees, birth year, prior employers, publications, patents and h_index remain unconfirmed and are left null/empty rather than guessed, per this project's sourcing rule. This session's web-search tool quota was exhausted before additional fresh search-engine queries could be run for Plotnikov beyond the two direct source re-fetches; no previously confirmed fact for either person was altered or deleted in this round. No new institutions were found for this ticker (new_institutions_found is empty for FESH). Added the top-level new_institutions_found key (matching the schema convention already used in other processed ticker files) as an empty list for this ticker, since both of Ivanov education[] institutions matched university_names.json exactly and Plotnikov has no education[] entries to normalize.
